user.title: Connect to the platform
user.description: Press Connect Home Assistant on your account page and paste the values it shows. Home Assistant sends its device list to the platform; The platform never connects to Home Assistant.

data_description.url: The API URL shown on your account page. It must start with https://.
data_description.tenant: The tenant shown on your account page.
data_description.api_token: The token created by Connect Home Assistant on your account page.

reauth_confirm.title: API token refused
reauth_confirm.description: The platform no longer accepts the API token. Paste a new one.

error.invalid_auth: The platform refused the token, or the token lacks the home-assistant permission.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the platform at that address.
error.url_not_https: The API URL must start with https://.

abort.already_configured: This tenant is already set up.
